description: Documentation and usage instructions for starting and stopping MockServer as a Node.js module or Grunt plugin, including configuration options and code examples.

methods.name: start_mockserver
methods.description: Starts the MockServer with specified options such as port, JVM options, version, verbosity, trace, debugging port, and startup retries.

methods.name: stop_mockserver
methods.description: Stops the MockServer on the specified port.
